title: Invalid Transactions
description: Identify transactions that exceed $1000 or occur within 60 minutes of another transaction by the same person in a different city.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize invalid set
2. For each transaction i:
3.   If amount > 1000, add to invalid
4.   For each transaction j:
5.     If name_i == name_j and city_i != city_j and abs(time_i - time_j) <= 60:
6.       Add to invalid

steps.note: Initialize invalid set and parse transactions.
Check against second transaction: j = 1 (alice, 50, 100, beijing).
Names match, cities differ, time diff 30 <= 60. Mark i=0 invalid.
Check against first transaction: j = 0 (alice, 20, 800, mtv).
Names match, cities differ, time diff 30 <= 60. Mark i=1 invalid.
